title: Letter to the Church in Colesville, 2 December 1830
source_note: JS and John Whitmer, Letter, Fayette Township, Seneca Co., NY, to “Dearly beloved in the Lord” [church members], [Colesville Township, NY], 2 Dec. 1830. Featured version copied [ca. 1871] in Newel Knight, History, 196–211; unidentified handwriting; private possession. For more complete source information, see the source note for Letter to Newel Knight and the Church in Colesville, 28 August 1830.
